name: winccoa-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server for WinCC OA - enables AI assistants to interact with WinCC OA projects
author: Richard Janisch

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_list_managers
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all WinCC OA managers in the current project with their status (running/stopped). Use this when the user asks about managers, processes, or what's running in the WinCC OA system.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_datapoints
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches for datapoints in the WinCC OA system by pattern. Supports wildcards (*). Use this when the user asks about datapoints, data, values, or wants to find specific system elements. Examples: 'System1:*', '*Pump*', 'ExampleDP_Arg1.'

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_value
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the current value of a specific datapoint element in WinCC OA. Use this when the user asks for the current value, state, or status of a specific datapoint. The datapoint must be specified in the format 'System:DpName.Element' (e.g., 'System1:Pump.state').
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get current value of a datapoint element

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_dptypes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists datapoint type definitions in WinCC OA. Use this when the user asks about datapoint types, structures, or data models. Supports pattern matching with wildcards.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_manager_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets detailed status information for a specific WinCC OA manager by name. Use this when the user asks about a specific manager's details, configuration, or state.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get detailed status of a specific manager

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_create_datapoint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new datapoint in the WinCC OA system. Use this when the user wants to add new datapoints to the system. Requires datapoint name and type.

dpeName.description: Name of the datapoint to create

dpId.description: Specific datapoint ID (optional, random if not provided)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_dp_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sets the value of a datapoint element in WinCC OA. **WARNING:** This directly controls industrial equipment. Use with extreme caution! Requires user confirmation before execution.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Write value to a datapoint (CAUTION: controls real equipment!)

value.description: Value to write (type depends on datapoint type)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_create_dp_type
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new datapoint type (DPT) with structure definition in WinCC OA. Use this when the user wants to define new data structures/templates for datapoints.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new datapoint type structure

structure.description: Structure definition (JSON tree with name, type, children)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_alarm_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Configures alarm thresholds and settings for a datapoint element. Supports binary alarms (BOOL) and analog alarms (numeric types with 1-3 thresholds). Use when the user wants to set up alarm monitoring.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Configure alarm thresholds for a datapoint

thresholds.description: Threshold values (1-3 values for analog alarms)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_alarm_delete
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes alarm configuration from a datapoint element. Use when the user wants to remove alarm monitoring. This action cannot be undone!
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delete alarm configuration from a datapoint

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_archive_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Configures archiving (historical data collection) for a datapoint element. Use when the user wants to enable historical data logging for trend analysis.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_common_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sets common configuration attributes for a datapoint element (description, alias, format, unit). Use when the user wants to add metadata or display properties to datapoints.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_pv_range_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sets min/max value range validation for a datapoint element. Use when the user wants to define valid value boundaries for inputs/outputs.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Set min/max value range for a datapoint

includeMin.description: Include min in valid range (default: true)

includeMax.description: Include max in valid range (default: true)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_modbus_address_get
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the current Modbus address configuration from a datapoint element. Returns reference, datatype, direction, connection and device IDs. Use to query existing peripheral address settings before modifying.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get Modbus address configuration from a datapoint

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_modbus_address_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Configures Modbus address settings for a datapoint element. Sets up both peripheral address (_address) and distribution (_distrib) configurations, connecting the datapoint to a Modbus device register. Use when connecting datapoints to Modbus devices.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Configure Modbus address for a datapoint

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_modbus_address_remove
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Removes Modbus address configuration from a datapoint element. Deactivates the address and clears distribution config.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Remove Modbus address from a datapoint

winccoa.mcp.logLevel.description: Log level for MCP Server Extension output
enumDescriptions: Show all messages (debug, info, warnings, errors)

winccoa.mcp.autoReconnect.description: Automatically reconnect to MCP Server when connection is lost

winccoa.mcp.reconnectRetries.description: Number of reconnection attempts before giving up (0-10)
